visual_description: A compact, high-torque handheld power saw with a medium-sized, serrated diamond blade. Unlike the large Rock Saw, this tool is built for two-handed precision. The body is a high-visibility industrial orange with ergonomic rubberized black grips. White plaster dust and dried mud are caked around the blade guard, and a yellow safety trigger is prominent on the handle.

constraints.material: Reinforced polymer housing in 'Dino Research' orange; brushed aluminum blade guard; steel blade with fine-tooth serration.
constraints.logic: Used specifically for 'Under-cutting' a fossil block and trimming the protective plaster jacket before transport.
